📍 Remote Romania
 🏢 Luxoft | DXC Technology
 Luxoft | DXC Technology is looking for a Senior Functional Tester with experience in the fashion industry to support a major digital transformation programme based on SAP S/4HANA.
 You will work closely with Business Users, Process Experts and Product Teams to prepare test cases, execute System Integration Testing (SIT), manage defects and ensure that business processes work as expected.
 Key responsibilities 
 • Write and validate test cases based on business process documentation
 • Prepare test data and support functional dry runs before SIT
 • Execute SIT test cases, document results and report defects
 • Track defects, coordinate with delivery teams and retest fixes
 • Act as the main testing contact for Process and Product Teams
 Requirements 
 • 5+ years of functional and end to end testing experience in ERP or retail transformation programmes
 • Hands on experience testing fashion industry processes, ideally assortment planning, buying or merchandising
 • Experience writing test cases and executing SIT with Business Users and Process Owners
 • Experience with Jira or similar defect management tools
 • English B2 or above
 Nice to have 
 • SAP S/4HANA and SAP Cloud ALM
 • TestRail or Signavio
 • ISTQB Foundation certification
 📍 Location: Remote, Romania
